verdict.rationale: Featurebase's 'single powerful inbox' spans in-app, Slack, Discord and email, implying PMs can respond to customers from a unified feedback/support view, and automatic ship notifications close the loop for shipped requests. However, no evidence explicitly documents a reply/comment thread inside an individual feedback record (e.g., a comment API or UI walkthrough) as a closed-loop mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of commenting/replying directly on a feedback post, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this loop-closing workflow.
